name: Truck Racing Pro
summary:
Truck Racing Pro is a high-intensity VR racing experience that puts you in control of powerful, heavy-duty trucks built for speed and domination. Feel the weight, torque, and raw engine power as you compete in adrenaline-fueled races across dynamic tracks designed to test your precision, control, and racing instincts.
